first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, with prior evidence of durable activation and adoption gains. Verify memory_86 for downstream qualified-revenue effects and memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest alternative but may attract lower-value cohorts or create discount dependence.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current completion and activation declines while supporting sustainable value. Promotional pricing is rejected despite qualified-revenue lift because verified retention fell 12% and the cohort did not survive first renewal. Measure qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation because long-term revenue impact remains uncertain.
